newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Village of Garden City, N.Y..

text.p: at Hawkins, Delafield &Wood, 67 Wall Street, New York, New
Bonds dated May 1, 1997, interest May 1 and November 1 each year commencing May 1, 1998. Bonds mature in principal installments on May 1 as follows:
$150,000 in each of the years 2003 to 2005,
Bids, accompanied by $32,300 good faith deposit check, must be for all $1,615,000 bonds. Award shall be based on net interest cost.

Bidders must refer to the full Notice of Sale for the complete terms and conditions of the sale. Copies of said Notice and the Official Statement may be promptly obtained from Fiscal Advisors &Marketing, Inc., 85 North Broadway, Hicksville, New York 11801, telephone number (516) 433-8555; fax number (516) 433-0628.
